name: OCS
note: Optical Circuit Switch — Google's all-optical interconnect. ASP $50k-$200k. MEMS dominant (mass production). Players: Lumentum, Coherent, Innolight (SiPh OCS 2027), Accelink, Robotechnik.

tables.title: OCS adoption & milestones
rows: Google TPU v4 — first OCS supercomputer (4,096 chips, 48 OCS)
Google TPU v7 SuperPod — OCS interconnects 9,216 chips
OCP OCS project (Lumentum, iPronics, Google, NVIDIA, Coherent, Microsoft)

Coherent OCS TAM held at >$4bn (doubled from $2bn at OFC 2026, 2030 basis; 'may have been conservative'); applications widened from scale-out to scale-across AND a clear path to SCALE-UP with active customer engagements; Q4 OCS revenue grew sequentially, expanding across TWO manufacturing locations, significant growth expected through FY2027 (Coherent Q4 FY2026)

OCS TEST demand broadening beyond the one self-building hyperscaler: Viavi already books some OCS revenue with 'the majority coming in the next several quarters'; it has been selling equipment to 'a big OCS vendor, hyperscaler, who makes their own stuff' and now sees 'many other companies looking to do more optical switching in their core' — 'I see this demand as being very healthy' (Viavi Q4 FY2026)
